description: Tracked cost ledger for the three early qwen/qwen3.7-flash OpenRouter runs (SAND-027-9 / issue #40). Rebuilds the QWEN-flash cost report without reports/experiment_log.jsonl.

price_pin.note: Verified against live /models and usage.cost on a smoke call; offline report uses this pin unless --prices overrides.

caveats: All three runs logged prompt_version mailroom-default — pinned simplified prompt stems were not recorded; these are cost figures, not prompt-fixed quality claims.
contracts-20 rows reported overall_extraction_score 0.0 with zero errors — measurement status is UNPROVEN (see issue #41); do not treat 0.0 as a validated accuracy result.

estimated_gpu_cost_usd on each record is the sandbox L4 GPU-proxy (wall/busy GPU-seconds × $/hr), NOT an OpenRouter API charge. Real API $ is recomputed from prompt/completion tokens × the price pin (or live /models when online).
